title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Your assistant answers a student's first question, and the student then types "Book it for 2 pm." The program sends the model only that new message, with no earlier messages. What happens?

options.text: The model has no way to tell what "it" refers to
The model recalls the first question from its own memory
The model looks the earlier chat up in its training data
The model books the machine that was used most recently

items.stem: In a made-up setup, each model call includes 2,000 tokens of fixed instructions and tool descriptions, plus one manual excerpt. Pasting a whole 20,000-token manual into all 5 calls of a chat sends how many manual tokens in total?
A run has grown long, and its history holds a 3,000-token printer manual page that was needed only for the first question. Which move keeps the run going and loses the least that still matters?

options.text: Switch to a model with a bigger window and keep every token
Clear that page and keep one line noting the answer it gave
Delete the whole history and start the next step from nothing
Ask the model to remember the page without saving it anywhere

items.stem: A student tells your assistant on Monday that they finished mill training. On Thursday they open a new chat and the assistant knows nothing about it. In one sentence, what did the program fail to do on Monday?

Your assistant must answer from 4 long machine manuals and also remember each student's training. In one or two sentences, which of the two should use retrieval and which should use saved notes, and why?
